mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below historical median) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that immediately increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% in a single month over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 2000.0) and slowing job growth (PAYEMS < 135000.0) signals economic weakness that triggers anticipatory monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST < 2000.0 and PAYEMS < 135000.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a monthly unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market strengthening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE declines by more than 0.2pp over a 1-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (relative to historical norms) signals weak consumer demand and corporate profit growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d SPX returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 2000.0 signals weakening consumer spending and corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 2000.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rapid inflation (CPIAUCSL growth > 0.5% monthly) and industrial contraction (INDPRO < 100.0) signals stagflation that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL growth > 0.5% (mo/mo) and INDPRO < 100.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an industrial contraction regime (INDPRO < 100.0), a monthly rebound in industrial production exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals manufacturing recovery that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO < 100.0, SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO increases by more than 0.5pp over a 1-month period.
